title: Teddeendi ndi Sanki
intro: Miijo-ɗee ɗoo : ruuhu ɓoorniiɗo comci laaɓtuɗi, taariiɓe ngalu ngu miijo mum alaa. Oo neɗɗo ina goongɗini wonde jawdi maɓɓe heɓaama e ƴoƴre maɓɓe, ɓe meeɗaa jaɓde iwdi riis goonga. Yahde e almuɓɓe annabi baawɗo, oo neɗɗo salii kala noddaango neɗɗaagu. Hannde, eɗen njiyloo sifaa limre nde ngalu mum mawngu wonti fooftorde maɓɓe cakkitiinde.
clues: Mi wuurii e jamaanu annabi nodduɗo leñol tiiɗngol e goonga.
Miɗo jeyaa e renndo cuɓaaɗo, tee ɓernde am ina woɗɗitoo nelal ngal.
Kaŋŋe e kaalis ɓuri mi welde e kala yamiroore Alla.
Keɓe am ina njaaji haa fedde worɓe tiiɗnde ina waawi ƴeftude coktirgal ngal.
Mi manniima wonde jawdi am rokkaa mi ko ganndal am.
E joofnirde, miin e hoɗorde am fof, leydi ndii ɓuuɓtii min, ko jeertinaango.

location.answer: Ngalu ngu coktirgal mum teddini worɓe semmbe heewɓe

Halki ɗum ko henndu ɓuuɓndu, ɓuuɓndu
Fiyi ɗum ko ɓuuɓol gootol mawngol

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
